## Editorial Standards
- All content written or reviewed by a licensed physician (MBChB)
- Claims supported by peer-reviewed research (PubMed, clinical trials)
- Content follows AHPRA (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency) guidelines
- Medical disclaimer included on all health-related articles
- No content makes diagnostic or prescriptive claims

## Core Topics & Expertise
EmpowerVida covers evidence-based longevity medicine including:
- Mitochondrial health and cellular energy optimization
- NAD+ biology, decline with age, and supplementation strategies
- Insulin resistance, metabolic flexibility, and type 2 diabetes prevention
- Brain fog, cognitive decline prevention, and neuroplasticity
- Biological age measurement (epigenetic clocks, PhenoAge)
- Supplement stacking: safety, synergies, and clinical dosing
- Gut-brain axis, intestinal barrier health, systemic inflammation
- Sleep architecture, glymphatic system, and recovery optimization
- Environmental toxin defense and cellular resilience
- Longevity biomarker testing and interpretation
